markdownToDocx.title: Markdown to Word
markdownToDocx.description: Paste Markdown or open a UTF-8 .md file to create a Word document locally. Supports headings, lists, tables, code and math; images and HTML are omitted.
markdownToDocx.shortDescription: Create a DOCX file locally from Markdown
markdownToDocx.privacy: Runs only in this browser. No upload, sign-in or saved document history.
markdownToDocx.dropHint: Or drop one UTF-8 .md file here. Maximum 1 MiB.
markdownToDocx.placeholder: Paste Markdown here, or load the example below…
markdownToDocx.fontHint: Fonts are not embedded or downloaded. The reader substitutes a local font if the selected font is unavailable.
markdownToDocx.imageNotice: Images and inline HTML are omitted from the preview and Word output. No external image is fetched. Ordinary links remain clickable in Word.
markdownToDocx.busyHint: Converting locally. Automatically stops after 30 seconds.
markdownToDocx.previewHint: For structure only. Math remains source text here; common formulas become editable equations in Word. Unsupported formulas may retain their source. Page breaks, fonts and layout may differ.
markdownToDocx.previewEmpty: Your content preview will appear here.

errors.tooLarge: Use a document of at most 1 MiB and 100,000 characters. Split larger documents before converting.
errors.invalidText: This is not valid UTF-8 text, or it contains binary data. Save it as a UTF-8 Markdown file.
errors.unsupportedFile: Choose or drop one .md or .markdown file.
errors.readFailed: The file could not be read. Select it again or paste its text.
errors.cancelled: Conversion cancelled. No result was saved.
errors.timeout: Conversion exceeded 30 seconds and was stopped. Try a shorter document.
errors.failed: The document could not be created. Simplify complex tables or formulas and try again.
